title: Graphing Points in a Problem
short: Plot data and read what each point means.

blocks.html: You can plot and read points on the coordinate plane. When the axes measure real things, like hours and dollars, each point tells a small story.
Each axis has a name and a scale. A point $(x, y)$ pairs one value from the across axis with one value from the up axis. To read the story, say both values with their units.

If you earn \$8 an hour, then 1 hour pairs with \$8, 2 hours with \$16, and so on. Each pair becomes a point: $(1, 8), (2, 16), (3, 24)$. The graph shows all the pairs at once, so you can read values, spot the pattern and predict the next point.
